@graph.name: Skin Boosters
@graph.description: Revitalize Your Skin Naturally with Skin Boosters Treatment in Bangalore Rejuvenate dull, tired, and aging skin with clinically proven injectable skin boosters
@graph.howPerformed: After your consultation, the area is cleansed and a numbing cream is applied. Tiny quantities of booster are injected into the mid-dermis with fine needles, and a soothing cream is applied afterwards. Before treatment, avoid alcohol and blood thinners for 24–48 hours. Afterwards, skip makeup for 12 hours, and avoid sun and heavy exercise for 24–48 hours.

acceptedAnswer.text: Skin boosters are a non-surgical, biocompatible treatment. At Derma Solutions, they are given under medical supervision, after screening for allergies.

mainEntity.name: How soon will I see results?

acceptedAnswer.text: Results usually appear within 5–7 days and improve progressively, with the best results visible from the second session.
Discomfort is minimal, thanks to numbing cream and very fine needles.

mainEntity.name: How are skin boosters different from dermal fillers?

acceptedAnswer.text: Skin boosters hydrate the upper skin layers for glow and softer lines. Dermal fillers work in deeper layers to restore volume and contour.
